_comment: Data for setup.ps1 -InstallPython (R6). Read by scripts/lib/rt-python-env.ps1. A path that does not exist is reported by name, never skipped (R3). 'exclude' names packages dropped from a requirements file before pip sees it: the file itself is never edited, because the skill that owns it still wants the line.

requirements.why: paper2talk: test_to_a4 (pypdf), the Jinja render path (jinja2), test_talk_pptx (python-pptx), OOXML reads (defusedxml)

scopus: requests (scopus_api, download_pdf), google-genai and openai (reviewers), curl_cffi (publisher tier), playwright (browser_fetch tier 8; the Chromium binary is a separate 'playwright install chromium')
extract-statistic: pymupdf and pymupdf4llm (extract_text.py), markitdown, psycopg and pgvector (corpus_index.py)

tools.why: security.md: pip-audit runs on every requirements file this installer applies. Pinned to the version found in the working environment on 2026-10-16; the install step used to call it without ever installing it.

venv_probe_timeout_s.provenance: chosen 2026-10-16 (R4): a scratch 'python -m venv' takes a few seconds on this machine; the ceiling only has to be finite (R10) and generous on a slow disk
